text: SUBJECT: Reset your Brightline Bank password|CONTENT: Hi Maria, we received a request to reset the password for your Brightline Bank online account. You can choose a new password by visiting https://login.brightlinebank.example/reset?token=7f3a91 within the next 60 minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your password will stay the same.

SUBJECT: Password reset request|CONTENT: Hello Tom, click the link below to set a new password for your Cloudyard account: https://accounts.cloudyard.example/reset/QW82-LLP. The link expires in 24 hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

SUBJECT: Password reset for your Sunrise Credit Union login|CONTENT: Hi Grace, we received a request to reset your online banking password at Sunrise Credit Union. Please go to https://online.sunrisecu.example/reset/ZP7731 and follow the steps. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your current password will continue to work until you change it. Thank you for banking with us.

SUBJECT: Reset your BlueHarbor Learning password|CONTENT: Hi Mei, a password reset was requested for your BlueHarbor Learning student account. Use this link to set a new password: https://learn.blueharbor.example/reset?u=mei.l&k=3380. The link expires in 2 hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

If that was you, visit https://secure.maplewoodins.example/reset/845-KQ and choose a new password. Our team will never ask for your password by phone or email. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

SUBJECT: Reset your password|CONTENT: Hi Nina, you requested a password reset for your Harbor Lane Coffee rewards account. Click here to create a new password: https://rewards.harborlanecoffee.example/reset?r=0092. The link lasts 24 hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

SUBJECT: Reset your Westfield Utilities online account password|CONTENT: Dear Rafael, we received a request to reset the password for your Westfield Utilities online account. To set a new password, please visit https://myaccount.westfieldutil.example/reset?ref=552917 within 60 minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. For questions, call our customer line at 555-0142 during business hours.

SUBJECT: Password reset for your Lumen Print Co. account|CONTENT: Hi Sofia, you asked to reset the password for your Lumen Print Co. customer account. Use the link below to choose a new password: https://orders.lumenprint.example/reset/gh77-plm. The link expires in 12 hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. We are happy to help with any other questions you have.

SUBJECT: New sign-in to your Brightline account|CONTENT: Hi Maya, we noticed a new sign-in to your Brightline account on March 3, 2025 at 9:14 AM. Device: Windows laptop (Chrome 122). Location: Portland, OR, USA. If this was you, you can ignore this message. If not, review your recent activity at https://account.brightline-mail.example/security and change your password right away.

No changes were made to your account. To see every session that is currently active, visit https://nwbank.example/sessions. Consider updating your password if you do not recognize this activity.

If this was you, no action is needed. If you think someone else used your account, change your password at https://greenfieldpay.example/password and then check your activity log.

Please confirm this was you on our activity page at https://oakline.example/activity. Thank you for helping keep your account safe.

If you did not sign in, please change your password and review recent account activity at https://pinecresthealth.example/account/security.

This message is to keep you informed. You can see active devices or change your password at https://ridgewayins.example/manage.

Thanks for reading with us,
The Quarry Books Team
